title: integrativebioinformatics/pulposeq pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline for isoform-level transcriptome assembly and lncRNA discovery from long-reads

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. The default `symlink` links results into `work/` rather than copying them, which uses no extra disk but means deleting `work/` destroys the published results. Use `copy` for an output directory that stands on its own. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

skip_nanocomp.description: NanoComp reports to skip: raw, restrander, chopper, minimap2, or all. Comma-separated for more than one, e.g. 'raw,chopper'. Unset runs every report.
skip_nanocomp.help_text: Selects reports only, never the tools they describe: chopper still filters and Restrander still orients with their reports turned off. The restrander report exists only for ONT_cDNA libraries the pipeline has to orient itself.

skip_chopper.description: Skip filtering and trimming with chopper. Its NanoComp report goes with it; the other reports still run.

skip_minimap2.description: Skip alignment to the reference genome, and with it every stage that consumes alignments: Bambu, classification and the report.

skip_bambu.description: Skip transcriptome assembly with Bambu, and with it every stage that consumes its transcriptome: classification, metadata refinement and the report.

library.description: Sequencing library type. Determines the minimap2 preset and Bambu strandedness.
library.help_text: ONT_cDNA covers both PCR-cDNA and direct-cDNA protocols. ONT_DRS and PacBio are always treated as stranded.

stranded_library.description: Whether the reads on disk are already oriented. Forced to true for ONT_DRS and PacBio; only meaningful for ONT_cDNA. This describes the FASTQ, not the chemistry: ONT PCR-cDNA is strand-specific chemistry whose basecalled reads are not oriented.

map_hq.description: Choose minimap2's splice:hq preset over splice. splice:hq is splice with -C5 -O6,24 -B4: a lower non-canonical junction penalty, costlier short gaps, cheaper long ones and a doubled mismatch penalty. It trusts the read, reading a discrepancy as real biology rather than basecalling error, so it suits accurate data (R10.4.1 sup, Iso-Seq) and can build junctions out of errors on noisy data. Leave unset to follow the library default: splice:hq for PacBio, splice for ONT cDNA. Set true or false to override for either, so both can be run each way and compared. Cannot be used with ONT_DRS, whose -k14 setting assumes the opposite error profile.

restrand_kit.description: Sequencing kit whose primer configuration Restrander should use. Required when restranding is active, unless --restrand_config is given. Choosing the wrong kit gives a low orientation rate rather than an error. 'trimmed' is for reads whose primers were already removed.

restrand_config.description: Optional custom Restrander config JSON, for protocols not covered by --restrand_kit. Overrides the kit preset when set.

restrand_min_frac.description: Minimum fraction of reads Restrander must orient, per sample. Any sample below this stops the run: there is no unstranded path, because unoriented reads reaching alignment and quantification erase mono-exonic novel transcripts and misclassify novel isoforms of known genes as antisense. Restrander reaches ~0.99 on matched PCR-cDNA data, so a failure usually means the kit or the trimming state is wrong.

skip_class.description: Skip transcriptome characterisation: classification, metadata refinement and the report. Bambu still runs.

coding_potential_pred.description: Tool used to predict coding potential for novel transcripts.
coding_potential_pred.help_text: CPC2 is the default and needs no organism. RNAmining requires --organism and is currently under review: on the pipeline's test data it called 86 of 100 GENCODE protein-coding transcripts non-coding, and invalidated 80 of the 88 it had called coding.

organism.description: Organism model used by RNAmining, e.g. Homo_sapiens. Required with --coding_potential_pred rnamining, and ignored by CPC2.

maxlen.description: Maximum read length (bp). Reads longer than this are discarded by chopper. Unset by default (no upper limit).

ndr.description: Bambu Novel Discovery Rate (NDR) threshold for novel transcript classification.
